notes.title: Patch-1.0.1 - Score Bug Fix
notes.notes: A patch to fix a bug that was causing the game to skip some levels and not allowing players to update their scores.

notes.title: Lefty Developer Livestream - Steam Next Fest 2024
notes.notes:
Steam Next Fest is here! So we'll be sharing a LEFTY Livestream to Celebrate! 

Join the Light Studio team for a detail-packed LEFTY Livestream during Steam Next Fest! We're answering LEFTY Community FAQs and revealing what inspired the game!

Don't miss it! And be sure to Wishlist and Play the Demo before Next Fest ends on Monday! 

Thanks once again for your support, 

The LEFTY Team

notes.title: LEFTY Weekly Social Media Highlights
notes.notes:
[h2]LEFTY Demo is OUT NOW! [/h2]

Last week marked the launch of our LEFTY Demo! This is your opportunity to play 5 of the game's opening levels ahead of launch!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45114271/3c9d5522a57908d89bbf22561cfaebf13de6cee4.png[/img]

Played already? Please send in your Demo Feedback: https://forms.gle/HdkQYqBSAy2BYPAh9

[h2] LoveEngineFive shared a LEFTY Showcase![/h2]

YouTuber LoveEngineFive posted a wholesome vid of her experience with the LEFTY Demo. 

[previewyoutube=BKJuavi95gs;full][/previewyoutube]

We LOVED seeing her perspective - and we will absolutely take her feedback into account. 

Are you a Creator? Get in touch - we’d love to set you up with codes to play the full game ahead of launch!

[h2]🙌 We revealed some footage of LEFTY’s later levels![/h2]

LEFTY’s about shifting your perspective, so we showed some footage of the increasing complexity of our game’s puzzles!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45114271/f57b243abcfdd65e8437473d3507eefbfe61712a.gif[/img]

Do you think you’ll be able to beat later levels?
